messages:
sam: Kicking off config-only rollout cfg_2026_03_21_15 for routing + batching. Suggest 10% canary for 15m, then staged ramp. https://go/release/cfg_2026_03_21_15

deploy-bot: Started rollout cfg_2026_03_21_15 by sam. Stages: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Reply `hold` to pause. Monitoring enabled.

miriam: Hold at 10% for 15m please. Ops requested quiet hold window first. Apply manual bump after validation. cc @ops-oncall

leo: ACK. I'll watch p99, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss, and queue depth. Dash: https://telemetry/release/cfg_2026_03_21_15

ops-oncall: FYI last similar change nudged tail latency at ~40k rps. If p99 > 600ms or 5xx > 0.5% during hold, rollback immediately.

sam: Added auto-rollback rule: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p99_latency > 600ms sustained for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> auto-rollback. Pin routing variant to v2-small for canary.

leo: Watchlist: `p99_latency`, `5xx_rate`, `kvcache_miss_rate`, `queue_drops`. Will post notes on any anomalies.

deploy-bot: Canary hold applied at 10% (requested by miriam). Timer: 15m. Live monitoring active.

ops-oncall: Quick check: batch_window_ms lowered from 12 -> 8ms in this config, right? Make sure downstream tokenizers / throttles don't blow up. If queue depth > 30, pause rollout.

sam: Correct: batch_window_ms = 8ms. Routing.weight non-critical tenants: 0.12 -> 0.05. Added soft-fallback route to `fallback-model` for cost control.

miriam: Changelog blurb to add:
- cfg_2026_03_21_15: batch_window_ms reduced to 8ms; non-critical tenant routing weight lowered; soft fallback route added. Canary: 10% hold 15m; rollback on p99>600ms or 5xx>0.5%.

leo: +1. Post-hold plan: nudge to 25% for 10m, then 50% for 15m if stable. Three-step full rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary timer expired. Hold ended; manual approval required to proceed from 10%.

miriam: Metrics look good: p99 ~ 380ms, 5xx 0.08%, kv_miss flat. Approve move to 25%.

sam: Moving to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Stage update: 25% applied. Auto-checks continue.

leo: Observed brief batch queue depth spike to 12 then normalized. No sustained anomalies.

ops-oncall: Reminder: call rollback on sustained queue depth > 30s or rising p99 trend. Otherwise green.

sam: Rollback command if needed: `deployctl rollback cfg_2026_03_21_15 --immediate`. Notify #incidents on rollback. Pin cfg id in release notes.

miriam: Adding final release note and marking as config-only deploy. Thanks team.
